reply_text:
I told Ilse in our DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I got that from her own 14 Oct message in the same DM.

I couldn't confirm it from gbrain. Reading back the saved note was refused because this bot's gbrain connection isn't tied to any member, and the brain serves several people, so nothing was read. This doesn't affect her answer, but stored notes like this one can't be read back until someone fixes it on the brain host. The fix is `gbrain auth rescope --token <this connection's token> --member <member>`. The other option is to set the connection up as a shared agent with `--may-act-for` and name the member on each call. That decision belongs to the brain's owner.
